Container.Name: Lingshu-Home
Container.Overview: A self-hosted personal dashboard for links, browser bookmarks, nested categories and modular widgets. Customize your homepage with a visual editor, Classic or iOS-inspired themes, and English or Simplified Chinese. SQLite is included; no external database is required. Open the WebUI to complete first-run setup. There is no default administrator password. Keep the /data mapping to preserve your database, saved icons and instance encryption keys. This template uses the published Linux amd64 release and runs as Unraid's appdata user (99:100). The image tag is pinned; read the upgrade guide before changing versions.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: lingshu home dashboard homepage bookmarks navigation startpage selfhosted
Container.Requires: Linux amd64 (x86-64). Persistent appdata storage writable by UID 99 and GID 100.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Host HTTP port. Keep the container port at 8080. Complete setup on your trusted LAN before configuring remote access.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Database, saved icons and instance keys. Keep this mapping when recreating or upgrading. Existing directories must be writable by UID 99 and GID 100.

Config.Name: Interface language
Config.Description: en: English; zh-CN: Simplified Chinese. Changing the interface language preserves your existing bookmarks and text.

Config.Name: HTTPS-only cookies
Config.Description: Keep false for direct HTTP access. Set true only when using Home through an HTTPS reverse proxy. This setting does not enable HTTPS itself.
